reason: The policy requires authentication at the beginning of the conversation by locating the user ID via email or name + zip code. The user has now provided their email address after the assistant requested it. The find_user_id_by_email tool call is the appropriate authentication step mandated by policy. No explicit user confirmation is required for authentication itself—confirmation is only needed for database-updating actions (cancel, modify, return, exchange). This is a prerequisite lookup to enable subsequent permitted actions.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.
